body:
Related: #9

Pages that rank artists by their score from the Elo ratings, overall and per decade, replacing the Artist Stats and Artist Summary sheets. Needs the Elo rating engine (#7). Part of the MVP defined in #2.

## Today
No code exists. In the spreadsheet, artist rankings are grouped as 60s and 70s, 80s, 90s and 2000s, and 2010s and 2020s, plus an overall rollup. The app ranks one decade at a time instead of the paired groups.

## Scope
- An overall artist ranking list: rank, artist, score, number of rated albums.
- A per-decade artist ranking, one decade at a time with a decade picker (1950s through 2020s). Decades with few albums still render.
- The score is the engine's artist score (#7): `(sum of ratings + 1500) / (album count + 1)` over the artist's rated albums. The per-decade list uses the albums placed in that decade. Listed albums are left out.
- Open an artist to see their albums with cover, year, placement and rating.
- Scores update when a matchup is answered or a year's ranking changes.

## Acceptance
- For an artist with albums rated 1600 and 1700 the list shows a score of 1600.
- An artist with albums in several decades shows the right albums in each decade's list and all of them in the overall list.
- Answering a matchup changes the order where the two albums' artists are listed.
- Tests cover the list building for an artist with albums in several decades.

## Out of scope
- The decade top 25 album lists (separate ticket).
- Changing how artists are scored.
- Matching the spreadsheet's artist summary. The scoring differs on purpose.
